The Reef

For Triggerfish users looking for capabilities and contributors who want to publish their own.

A PROJECT BY GREG HAVENS

THE PROJECT, IN PRACTICE

What you can do with it.

01

Discover skills and plugins

Static catalogs describe available packages, versions, tags, and metadata.

02

Contribute through GitHub

Submit a pull request with a versioned skill or plugin and the required metadata.

03

Validate before publication

Repository checks validate submissions and rebuild the published JSON indexes.

FROM IDEA TO USE

How it works.

  1. 01

    Find or create a capability

    Browse the catalogs or prepare a versioned package.

  2. 02

    Submit it for review

    Follow the contribution instructions and open a pull request.

  3. 03

    Publish to the registry

    Accepted submissions become part of the generated static indexes.

What the registry publishes
Skills   → catalog, tags, categories
Plugins  → catalog, tags, categories
Versions → metadata + package content

Registry structure summarized from its public source.
